title: Compact, Regular and Comfortable in Tech and Board View, Regular by default
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A brand-new user (no saved density).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Density control in List, Tech View, and Board View.
  2. Confirm the three options Compact, Regular, Comfortable in each.
  3. As the new user, confirm Regular is selected by default.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Compact, Regular and Comfortable density are offered in Tech View and Board View (not List).
  • Without a saved choice, Regular is the default.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10049 — Density in Tech View and Board View. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), requirement(s) S6-R1, S6-R5 (read 30 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R1: “Offer Compact, Regular, and Comfortable density in Tech View and Board View.”
  • S6-R5: “Use Regular as the default density.”
